```text
Format YAML templates

Usage:
  ytt fmt [flags]

Flags:
      --debug              Enable debug output
  -f, --file stringArray   File (ie local path, HTTP URL, -) (can be specified multiple times)
  -h, --help               help for fmt
  -s, --strict             Configure to use _strict_ YAML subset
```
